match.title: India vs Sri Lanka
match.h2h: India and Sri Lanka have faced each other 171 times in ODI cricket, with India holding a commanding 99-59 head-to-head advantage alongside 11 no-results and 2 ties. Sri Lanka won their most recent bilateral ODI series 2-0 at home in August 2024, snapping a long Indian winning streak in the format.
